name: Phishing
description: Reported or detected phishing mail: triage the mail, find who clicked, contain the endpoint if something ran.
author: kubesoc
summary:
Reported by:
Mail subject / sender:
Recipients:
Delivered at:
Attachment or link:
Users who clicked:

tasks.title: Preserve the mail and extract indicators
tasks.description: Get the original message with headers. Add sender, reply-to, URLs, attachment SHA-256 and delivery IPs as IOCs on the case - the Velociraptor collector fills artifact parameters from them (sha256 -> Hashes, domain/hostname -> Domains, ip-* -> IPs).

tasks.title: Find who received and who clicked
tasks.description: Search the mail gateway and proxy logs for the sender, the subject and the URLs. Add every affected endpoint as an asset on this case, named exactly as the host is enrolled in Velociraptor.

tasks.title: Triage collection on each endpoint that opened the mail
tasks.description: Tag the asset velociraptor:contain:triage. Approve the task the collector opens (an approver group member, not the requester). The collection, its SHA-256 chain of custody and the results land on this timeline.

tasks.title: Remove or quarantine the attachment if it was saved
tasks.description: With the attachment SHA-256 as an IOC on the case, tag the asset velociraptor:contain:quarantine-file (copy kept) or remove-file (deleted outright), then approve.

tasks.title: Reset credentials of anyone who entered them
tasks.description: Force a password reset and revoke active sessions and refresh tokens in Keycloak for every user who submitted credentials.

tasks.title: Block sender, URLs and hashes
tasks.description: Push the IOCs to the mail gateway, the proxy and MISP so the next mail from this campaign is stopped.

tasks.title: Close-out: what let it through
tasks.description: Record which control missed it (filtering, awareness, macro policy) and what changes were made.
